_comment: Visual ground-truth bounce calls for input_video_h264.mp4, labelled by inspecting eval/bounce_montages/ frame-by-frame. Keyed by shot-interval start frame. 'unresolvable' = the bounce frame/IN-OUT cannot be determined from this single behind-baseline camera (net crossing, tracking jump, or far-baseline call at the resolution limit).

191.note: mid-court service area, ball visible IN

304.note: CLOSE - lands on/just inside far baseline, borderline

220.note: far player, tracking jumps across court

377.note: near-player hit vs bounce ambiguous (tracking clean though)

449.note: far-baseline close call at resolution limit
